scope: Correct stale test contracts for the five reviewed pet repairs; no production model or runtime changes in this correction

changes.finding: Main PR 476 deleted world-pet-companion.ts while the supplemental source list retained it. The PR merge checkout therefore failed with ENOENT.
changes.correction: Integrate PR 477 commit 1cb62ac9ca85ea5db731bfd114fcbe2ce5ee71d8, removing only the retired path.

changes.finding: The reviewed Worldstorm head/neck actions and Azure terminal root fall deliberately use 121 LINEAR quaternion samples. The old test required CUBICSPLINE for every sampler.
changes.correction: Accept only the exact reviewed pet, clip, target, repair revision, 121-key count and repair metadata. Keep CUBICSPLINE and tripled tangent/output counts on every other sampler.

changes.finding: Azure's reviewed whole-rig death fall adds root rotation, which the old limb-only target list rejected.
changes.correction: Accept root rotation only for mythic-6 death with the exact terminal-collapse revision, 121 keys, 84.6-degree roll and declared two-track scope. All other target checks remain.

changes.finding: At idle phase .07 the legacy ankle-pivot metric is .01877797, but the actual visible soles remain supported. The frozen prior source has the same foot measurements; this is a joint-proxy mismatch.

independentMeasurementReview.conclusion: The actual visible-sole bound is stricter than the old ankle-origin bound. Airborne gait phases are not treated as planted contact.

changes.independentSoleSelection: Bind-world geometry within .025 above the production static ground percentile, z in [-.04,.14], left x>.035 or right x<-.025. No skin weights consulted; source counts 458 left and 433 right.
changes.correction: For the exact reviewed Rabbit source, measure the visible sole patches and full-mesh loop seam. Require absolute sole distance below .003 model units. Preserve the existing bone checks for other pets and Pebble's nonnegative sole check.
changes.limitation: Gallop phases .2/.3 have roughly 1.15–2.05mm negative sole distance against the static percentile plane in both prior and current sources. The signed 3mm bound retains this reviewed baseline; this record does not claim nonnegative clearance at every gait sample.

localValidation.scope: Integrated candidate, including full-model and LOD payload checks across the 161-pet roster
